title: My ex said he was doing No Nut November

hooks.text: My ex told me he was doing No Nut November.
Why would I deceive you? - my ex, three days before I found out.
My best friend bought my ex's hoodie from me.

beats.text: My ex told me he was doing *No Nut November*.
beats.visual: Tiff deadpan; Jake behind her, hand on heart, saintly.

beats.text: Day three, I found out he was failing it... with my *best friend*.
beats.visual: DAY 3 tag; Mia slides in next to Jake; Tiff shocked.

beats.text: I asked him straight up. He goes: why would I *deceive* you?
beats.visual: Jake close-up, smug innocent face, hand on chest.

beats.text: Then Mia posts a story. In his hoodie. In his *bed*.
beats.visual: Jake's room: Mia in his grey hoodie on his bed, peace sign; story frame overlay.

beats.text: I cried into my clothes pile for two days. The only thing in my room that still *hugged* me.
beats.visual: Night, Tiff crying slumped by her chair pile.

beats.text: Then he texts me: you were never worth the *effort*. And the group chat *laughed*.
beats.visual: Phone message pops; laughing emoji tags; Tiff devastated.

beats.text: So I sold *everything* he ever gave me.
beats.visual: Morning: Tiff determined, snaps the pile; listing boards pop.

beats.text: The hoodie sold in ten minutes. The buyer? *Mia*.
beats.visual: SOLD tag; buyer name MIA; Tiff's jaw drops then smirks.

beats.text: She paid full price to wear it for a guy who already left her *too*.
His stuff? Gone. My chair? Back. Listed everywhere with *pileGo*.
beats.visual: Plug: empty chair, pileGo! sign, marketplace boards.
